verdict.rationale: PayPal's REST docs explicitly invite developers to explore REST API descriptions, generate client code, and import OpenAPI documents into third-party tools. The official paypal-rest-api-specifications repo shows OpenAPI JSON files such as openapi/checkout_orders_v2.json being used for code generation. llms.txt and markdown docs probes add further machine-readable surfaces. missing for 10: an explicit direct download URL or catalog of which APIs have published specs, independent or hands-on corroboration that the specs are complete and current.
